paragraphs.text: The Belligerent (occasionally stylized as The Belligerent ) is a tall ship of the Brazen Coalition of pirates that was captained by Vraska during her time on Ixalan .

The Belligerent is an immense, wooden tall ship. Its brilliantly colored sails are latticed with intricate rope. Written in graceful script on the side of the bow is the epigraph: The Belligerent . A Legion of Dusk vampire ship captain turned to stone by Vraska's gaze is strapped to the front of the ship, serving as its figurehead. It carries a dinghy attached by hooks, which can be lowered and used as an away vessel.
During the story of Ixalan in 2 Dawn Era , the Belligerent' s crew included:
A motley collection of Brazen Coalition humans , ogres , and goblins
Jace Beleren briefly served as the captain's guest
